title: Toggle Switch
content: Build accessible toggle switch component. Structure: button with sliding indicator. Track: w-11 h-6 rounded-full, off state bg-gray-200, on state bg-blue-600. Thumb: w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-white shadow, translate-x animation. Animation: transition-all duration-200. States: on/off with distinct colors. Keyboard: Space or Enter to toggle. Accessibility: role="switch", aria-checked.

variants.simple: Create on/off toggle switch with sliding animation.
variants.detailed: Build accessible toggle switch component. Structure: button with sliding indicator. Track: w-11 h-6 rounded-full, off state bg-gray-200, on state bg-blue-600. Thumb: w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-white shadow, translate-x animation. Animation: transition-all duration-200. States: on/off with distinct colors. Keyboard: Space or Enter to toggle. Accessibility: role="switch", aria-checked.
variants.advanced: Build accessible toggle switch component with multiple variants. Structure: button element with sliding thumb indicator. Track: w-11 h-6 rounded-full, off state bg-gray-200 (or bg-gray-300), on state bg-blue-600 (or custom color prop). Thumb: w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-white shadow-sm, positioned with transform translate-x (translate-x-0.5 for off, translate-x-[22px] for on). Animation: transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out for smooth sliding. States: on/off with distinct track colors, loading state with small spinner (w-3 h-3 animate-spin) inside thumb replacing content, disabled state with opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed. Labels: optional labels on each side ("Off" / "On"), or single label to the right describing the toggle. Label clicking toggles the switch. Size variants: sm (w-9 h-5, thumb w-4 h-4), md (w-11 h-6, thumb w-5 h-5), lg (w-14 h-7, thumb w-6 h-6) with proportional dimensions. Controlled component: value (boolean) and onChange props, support both controlled and uncontrolled modes with internal state. Keyboard: Space or Enter to toggle when focused (button element handles this natively). Focus ring: visible focus indicator (focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-blue-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2). Accessibility: role="switch" (implicit with button), aria-checked={value}, aria-label or associated label for screen readers. Icon inside thumb: optional Check icon when on, X icon when off, with smooth fade transition. Loading: disable interaction during async state changes, show spinner, revert on error. Custom colors: allow custom on/off colors via props.
